subject: general
question: Seven people, D, E, F, G, H, I and X, are sitting in a row facing North. Only two people sit to the left of G. Only three people sit between G and H. Only one person sits between H and F. E sits to the immediate left of I. D is not an immediate neighbour of H. How many people sit to the right of X?
solution:
Given: Seven people, D, E, F, G, H, I and X, are sitting in a row facing North.

1) Only two people sit to the left of G.

2) Only three people sit between G and H.

3) Only one person sits between H and F.

4) E sits to the immediate left of I.

5) D is not an immediate neighbour of H.

And, N will sit at the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83e97371c4e3dfdae910508649bca4938bb6e3ae8774e76dbad66aeba536215d.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d434ec5d818c1da7aacbc50d52f845f857f11cef18a0d95efa7555fcc422a02f.png] 

So, There is only **1**** **person who sit to the right of X.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
